# Yandex Tiles API attribution asset

`yandex-logo-ru.svg` is unmodified from the official logo archive linked at
https://yandex.ru/maps-api/docs/tiles-api/index.html (downloaded 2026-11-02):
https://download.cdn.yandex.net/tech/ru/zout_maps-tiles/doc/dg_5991b5839950b3d45e6991d40308f5a6/files/yandex_logo.zip

Archive member: `yandex_logo/SVG/yndex_logo_ru.svg` (88 × 48, including clear space).
It is shown in a corner of the map, linked to https://yandex.ru/maps/,
only when the official Yandex Tiles API is enabled.

API integration: https://yandex.ru/maps-api/docs/tiles-api/request.html
`projection=web_mercator` is required for Leaflet EPSG:3857. Do not substitute
undocumented tile servers. The API key must belong to the site owner and be
restricted to the appropriate domain in the Yandex developer console.
